\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{طریقہ} (tarīqā)}{طریقہ (tarīqā)}]{\ur{طریقہ} (tarīqā) — a method; a way (of doing)}

\label{lesson:UR-C380-tariqa}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for without a break, then the Urdu for to go over again.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{طریقہ}}
\textbf{\ur{طریقہ}} — \emph{tarīqā} — \textquotedblleft{}a method; a way (of doing)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{یہ} \ur{طریقہ} \ur{نہیں} \ur{چلا} \ur{تو} \ur{ہم} \ur{دوسرا} \ur{سوچیں} \ur{گے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar yih tarīqā nahīṅ chalā to ham dūsrā socheṅ ge.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If this method does not work, we will think of another.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{طریقہ}} (\emph{tarīqā}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{ṭarīqa}, \textquotedblleft{}a path, a way\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tarīqā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tarīqā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar yih tarīqā nahīṅ chalā to ham dūsrā socheṅ ge.} — If this method does not work, we will think of another.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for without a break, then the Urdu for to go over again, then say \emph{tarīqā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{طریقہ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A method; a way (of doing)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{سوجھنا} (sūjhnā)}{سوجھنا (sūjhnā)}]{\ur{سوجھنا} (sūjhnā) — to occur to (someone); to strike}

\label{lesson:UR-C380-sujhna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for practice, then the Urdu for nerve.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{سوجھنا}}
\textbf{\ur{سوجھنا}} — \emph{sūjhnā} — \textquotedblleft{}to occur to (someone); to strike\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{مجھے} \ur{کوئی} \ur{حل} \ur{سوجھا} \ur{تو} \ur{میں} \ur{بتاؤں} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar mujhe koī hal sūjhā to maiṅ batāūṅ gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If a solution occurs to me, I will tell you.
\end{quote}

Past (it …): \ur{وہ} \ur{خیال} \ur{اچانک} \ur{سوجھا}, \emph{voh khayāl achānak sūjhā}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{سوجھنا}} (\emph{sūjhnā}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{sūjhnā}, \textquotedblleft{}to be perceptible, to occur to\textquotedblright{}, under Sanskrit \emph{śúdhyati}, \textquotedblleft{}becomes clear\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 12527); \textbf{\ur{سجھانا}}, \textquotedblleft{}to suggest\textquotedblright{}, is its partner.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sūjhnā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar mujhe koī hal sūjhā to maiṅ batāūṅ gā.} — If a solution occurs to me, I will tell you.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for practice, then the Urdu for nerve, then say \emph{sūjhnā} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{جٹنا} (juṭnā)}{جٹنا (juṭnā)}]{\ur{جٹنا} (juṭnā) — to get down to (a task); to apply oneself}

\label{lesson:UR-C380-jutna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for nerve, then the Urdu for to occur to.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{جٹنا}}
\textbf{\ur{جٹنا}} — \emph{juṭnā} — \textquotedblleft{}to get down to (a task); to apply oneself\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{سب} \ur{جٹ} \ur{گئے} \ur{تو} \ur{کام} \ur{جلدی} \ur{ختم} \ur{ہو} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar sab juṭ gae to kām jaldī khatm ho gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If everyone gets down to work, it will soon be done.
\end{quote}

Past (he …): \ur{وہ} \ur{کام} \ur{میں} \ur{جٹ} \ur{گیا}, \emph{voh kām meṅ juṭ gayā}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{جٹنا}} (\emph{juṭnā}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{juṭnā}, \textquotedblleft{}to come together\textquotedblright{}, under \emph{*yuṭati}, a form it reconstructs (CDIAL 10496); the sense \textquotedblleft{}to throw oneself into a task\textquotedblright{} is a later one our sources do not trace.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\end{itemize}
